verdict.rationale: OpenAI documents a hosted self-serve fine-tuning path: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (RFT) for adapting OpenAI models to custom data, plus pricing sections for fine-tuning. This is API-based fine-tuning of closed models rather than tunable open weights, and there is no independent/hands-on evidence corroborating the fine-tuning workflow's ease or results. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the fine-tuning pipeline, open-weight tuning option, and detail on dataset prep/eval loop beyond guide summaries.
